'''Yulcris''' was a muscular [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. He worked for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor]], hunting prisoners in the Moff's [[Game Chambers]]. He was armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].
